 3 die, 1,535 hospitalised with dengue in 24 hours
 Death toll this year rises to 455 
 Published : 6 November 2026
 • 
 Updated : 6 November 2026, 19:34
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least three dengue patients died, and 1,535 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Dhaka division and one in Khulna division.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths, the death toll rose to 455, while the cumulative number of cases reached 145,906.
 Currently, 5,773 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
